title: a16z Podcast: Taking the ‘Cyber’ Out of Cybersecurity

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Nearly every cybersecurity discussion/presentation follows this formula: We don’t know what we’re doing; the bad guys are getting smarter.
reader_summary.overview: Nearly every cybersecurity discussion/presentation follows this formula: We don’t know what we’re doing; the bad guys are getting smarter; our defenses are getting worse. But even though security itself has obviously changed in many ways and not in others. That’s not to minimize the seriousness or cost of cyber attacks!

key_points.text: Nearly every cybersecurity discussion/presentation follows this formula: We don’t know what we’re doing; the bad guys are getting smarter.
But even though security itself has obviously changed in many ways and not in others.
It’s just that changing the conversation here will let us pay attention to the fact that “cybersecurity” these days is really… “security”.
